ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio featuring approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) central pixels and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity dark central mass. High-intensity white mottling is restricted to the outer lobe extremities. The left tip contains an irregular white patch with internal dark focal spots; the right tip displays a white region with a series of circular dark clusters near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70 degrees and significant vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration across both lobes. High-frequency peaks with varying pixel-amplitudes (2-8 pixels) are most prominent on the distal thirds of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve transitioning into sharp, slightly tapered tips at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity clusters (diameter 4-10 pixels) located within the high-intensity white patches on both distal lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A group of 4-6 distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear marks visible on the dark region of the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the lower-left towards the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks on the lower left lobe and irregular, jagged indentations along the trailing edge indicative of physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, jagged pixel boundary on the far right tip, suggesting significant tissue erosion or unique structural wear.
